posts.title: Now
posts.description: Another semester starts in a week! I have some awesome courses lined up and can’t wait. Hopefully my other ventures won’t eat into my ability to put in the required effort. These are: Planning my wedding 👰🥂🤵 Lecturing about digital forensics Climbing Sticking with the guitar. If I manage that - I’ll buy myself an electric one 🎸🤘🏽
